title: NFL Football
description:
Atlanta Falcons at Pittsburgh Steelers
The Pittsburgh Steelers host the Atlanta Falcons in Week 1 NFL action at Acrisure Stadium. The Steelers finished the previous season first in the AFC North with a 10-7 record, while the Falcons finished third in the NFC South with an 8-9 record.

title: NFL Football
description:
Washington Commanders at Philadelphia Eagles
The Eagles host the Commanders in Week 1 NFL action at Lincoln Financial Field. The Eagles enter this matchup after splitting their 2025 head-to-head series 1-1. The Eagles finished last season with an 11-6 record, while the Commanders finished 5-12.
